news.title: Cantor Fitzgerald Initiates Overweight on Oklo
news.text: Cantor Fitzgerald began coverage of Oklo with an Overweight rating and a $73 price target, citing strong demand for advanced microreactors.

news.title: NRC Readiness Assessment Completed
news.text: Oklo completed the Nuclear Regulatory Commission readiness assessment, advancing licensing efforts for its Aurora powerhouse.

news.title: Oklo and Vertiv Announce Data Center Collaboration
news.text: Oklo partnered with Vertiv to co-develop power and cooling solutions tailored to hyperscale and colocation data centers.

news.title: Oklo Teams with Liberty Energy on Integrated Power
news.text: Oklo and Liberty Energy unveiled a next-generation integrated power offering combining microreactors with energy services.

news.title: BNP Paribas Exane Starts Oklo at Underperform
news.text: BNP Paribas Exane initiated coverage with an Underperform rating and $14 price target, flagging commercialization risks.

news.title: Daiwa Upgrades Oklo to Outperform
news.text: Daiwa America upgraded Oklo from Hold to Outperform and raised its price target on improving execution milestones.

news.title: Q2 2025 Results Call Scheduled
news.text: Oklo scheduled its second-quarter 2025 financial results and business update call for August 11.

news.title: Oklo and Lightbridge Evaluate Additional Co-Location Opportunities
news.text: Oklo said it would explore further co-location sites with Lightbridge to convert legacy nuclear materials into fuel for Oklo reactors.

news.title: Oklo Chosen for DOE Reactor Pilot Program
news.text: The U.S. Department of Energy selected Oklo for three projects under its reactor pilot program, supporting commercialization efforts.

news.title: Oklo Signs MOU with ABB and Opens Monitoring Room
news.text: Oklo signed a memorandum with ABB and commissioned a monitoring room to prepare workforce training for Aurora deployments.

news.title: Oklo Announces Tennessee Fuel Recycling Facility
news.text: Oklo unveiled plans for a fuel recycling facility in Tennessee as the first phase of a potential $1.68 billion advanced fuel center.

news.title: Groundbreaking Held for First Aurora Powerhouse
news.text: Oklo broke ground on its inaugural Aurora powerhouse, marking a key step toward commercial deployment.

news.title: Fuel-Assembly Flow Testing Completed at Argonne
news.text: The company completed full-scale fuel-assembly flow testing at Argonne National Laboratory to validate reactor components.

news.title: Oklo and Blykalla Form Transatlantic Partnership
news.text: Oklo joined with Blykalla to accelerate advanced reactor commercialization across the U.S. and Europe.

news.title: Barclays Sets $146 Price Target on Oklo
news.text: Barclays initiated coverage with a $146 target, emphasizing Oklo's long-term market opportunity.

news.title: NRC Accepts Oklo Topical Report for Accelerated Review
news.text: The NRC accepted Oklo's principal design criteria topical report under an accelerated review schedule.

news.title: DOE Selects Oklo for Advanced Fuel Line Pilot Program
news.text: The Department of Energy chose Oklo among four companies to build pilot advanced nuclear fuel lines.

news.title: DOE Names Oklo to Advanced Fuel Line Pilot Projects
news.text: Oklo confirmed DOE selection for advanced nuclear fuel line pilot projects, reinforcing its fuel supply strategy.

news.title: Oklo and newcleo Forge Strategic Partnership
news.text: Oklo, newcleo, and Blykalla announced a strategic collaboration to strengthen the nuclear fuel ecosystem.

news.title: Q3 2025 Earnings Call Date Announced
news.text: Oklo scheduled its third-quarter 2025 financial results and business update call for November 12.
